body: Founder, live: i believe i am dead -> yea i logged in as most recent client - i think im dead so nothing works but it doesnt respawn me -> ensuring my character gets moved to the home point if im dead on login. Investigated the founder's own real test@test.com/TestWarrior character live via IDUNA + the MUD HTTP API: confirmed HP 1/90 (not literally 0 -- alive but critical, the game's own intentional FFXI-style post-KO weakness), no active aggro, Home Point set to Meadow -- consistent with a real earlier KO+auto-respawn (this session's own earlier feature) having already resolved their immediate danger, but the founder's broader concern (a KO'd session not reliably recovering on reconnect) was real and separate. Root cause: getOrCreateHeadlessPlayer reuses an existing headless session across client reconnects (survives as long as it hasn't been idle-evicted) with no recovery check at all -- a character KO'd in a previous session stayed exactly KO'd until they happened to type home themselves. Extracted cmdHome's real KO-to-Home-Point logic into performHomeRespawn and call it whenever an existing session is picked back up with IsKO still true. Live-verified against an isolated test instance (separate port 2324/7172, same real IDUNA backend, the live gfd-mud.service left completely untouched during testing): created a disposable character, killed it via real combat against live worms (no shortcuts), confirmed a genuine KNOCKED OUT / HP:0 state, then issued a normal next command with no home anywhere in it -- the real respawn text fired automatically before that command's own dispatch ran, landing the character back at their Home Point at HP 1/90 with IsKO cleared. Deployed to the live service (GOWORK=off go build + systemctl --user restart gfd-mud.service, matching the documented deploy procedure) -- go test ./... (GOWORK=off) passes across every package. Also found and flagged a separate, real, NOT-yet-fixed gap while investigating: a custom Home Point set via sethome is persisted to IDUNA (characters.home_scene_id/home_pos_x/y/z columns exist) but never reloaded when a fresh headless session is created (getOrCreateHeadlessPlayer always calls homepoint.NewState(ch.SceneID), discarding any prior custom home point) -- as a direct, visible side effect of restarting the live service to deploy this fix, the founder's own real character's Home Point reverted to unset and will need sethome again. Not fixed in this pass; flagged for follow-up. Commit 82f72a5/3b9af90.
title: Auto-recover a KO'd character on the next real command, not just home
